posts.title: When Rails Conventions Are Not Enough
posts.description: Why business logic in a growing Rails application bounces between fat controllers and fat models, and how service objects and layered architecture give it a home.

posts.title: Callbacks, Concerns, and Current: Avoiding Hidden Dependencies in Rails

posts.title: From Conditionals to Polymorphism
posts.description: A conditional that keeps growing is a design problem, not a style problem. How to turn each branch into an object, one green step at a time.
